reader_policy.zip: STORED or DEFLATED only, no encryption/duplicates/paths/external members, exact names; NPY1.0/2.0 C-order; preflight all ZipInfo/header sizes before np.load; expected bytes=header+shape product*itemsize, no trailing data; no object or pickle; pre-read6byteMAGIC+2version+u2(v1)/u4(v2) header length and reject>16384 BEFORE header allocation. Pass max_header_size=16384 explicitly to both header reader and np.load. NPY3 rejected. Directory entries prohibited.
reader_policy.snapshot: pin exact bytes from stable path/handle within cap before parsing, bytes retained per archive; before/after identity and same-handle SHA. File reparse rejected; authorized source root exact; no fallback paths; I/O unavailable ->INCONCLUSIVE_SOURCE_IO with actual exception type; no attribution to cloud/sync. Only current archive plus shared compact data retained; release per-pilot before next.
reader_policy.consumer: new independent semantic walker; may share bounded I/O primitives only, not producer check functions nor expected output builder; reads pinned sources itself. Compare all terminal coverage and per-array byte digest, not producer self-SHA; cannot import producer semantic functions or META/instance_guard/coverage_guard. Independently declare semantics; may share I/O and digest utility only. No shared output constructor.
reader_policy.format: reports include all5509 catalog rows incl NOT_SAVED plus6proxy-only rows; prototype references to array rows/runs without geometry replication; one pilot binding row per201; retain multiplicity and all layer distinctions. Metadata report no geometry values.

identities.source_universe: 5509 =5437 nonvegetation+72 vegetation; indices retained from catalog, not packed
identities.prototype_universe: 5443=5437 nonvegetation catalog indices +6 proxy-only indices; 5515 report rows total
identities.meta_model: exact set of nonvegetation catalog indices, NOT range(5443)
identities.meta_source_model: exact model-sections index set: nonvegetation + proxy-only; may exceed5508
identities.proxy: -1 for kinds0/1, integer0..6 for kind2; route root_model==meta.model and source_model==meta.source_model; traverse slots against saved model-sections proxies by literal slot; cycles/unknowns rejected
identities.face_and_section: source_model LOD row, face>=0 and <lod.faces, section exact stored index in that lod; kind0 is Roadway, kind1 root Visual water, kind2 conditional proxy; retain multiplicity
identities.normalization: ASCII only, no control/NUL/drive/.. traversal or empty internal components; replace backslash with slash, lower, strip outer slash; raw preserved. Match canonical catalog name. Never basename fallback.

epoch_binding.surface_inputs: source_pins exact named WRP compiled/editable and pilot PBO declarations match epoch, no reopening binaries
epoch_binding.pilot_inputs: pins[surface inputs path] equals its contract SHA and pins[instances path] equals instances archive SHA; original surface artifact manifest SHA preserved. Verify all specified links, not substring matches
epoch_binding.selected: surface inputs source_pins[selected path] and discovery_artifacts selected entries match contract SHA/bytes; instances columns and selected columns dtype,shape,data bytes exact
epoch_binding.test_mutation: epoch_wrong_pbo changes pinned input JSON declaration in fixture and repins only fixture; no external PBO opened

pilot_constraints.counts: 201 rows/model indices/instanceIDs/names unique; site counts139/26/9/27 from metadata; one instance per selected model; all catalog rows retained
pilot_constraints.source_grid: n,m>=2; n*m<=3B; body_rows=n-cap_before-cap_after>=2. npz_start is GLOBAL station-array offset>=0, NEVER require npz_start+body_rows<=n(local grid). Global station-end not checked without source arrays; recorded as NOT_EVALUATED. source_triangles indices0<=idx<n*m; extrema row/col must match each triangle independently; category count/alphabet from source_regions; map permutation range0..B-1, no missing/duplicate mapping since historicalunmapped0
pilot_constraints.category: dtype<U9 exactly; valuesBODY/CAP_START/CAP_END only; compare count per source_regions, no new geometry thresholds
pilot_constraints.face_n: 3or4 and unused padded rows exactlypositivezero bytes; legit zero vertex included whenindex<n
pilot_constraints.orientation: source payload bytes/order preserved; no new oriented equality between MLOD and compiled; historical checks copied as evidence only; not mistaken for current verification
